purpose: Independent hardware repetition question; earlier frozen, caller and worker fixtures remain unchanged.

questions.query: Did the long Rapier Rayon stalls reproduce on TITAN RTX hardware rendering, and does that isolate GPU causation?
facts: Three profiling-off/on pairs on verified TITAN RTX hardware ANGLE/D3D11 have zero >40 ms steps in 5761 callbacks, maximum 3.105 ms: non-reproduction in that cohort.
With zero long events, CPU-versus-off-CPU classification remains inconclusive; unavailable WPR means no local ETW worker-state conclusion.
CPU, OS and automatic pool sizes differ from the hosted software-renderer cohort, so this is not GPU-only causal proof or a universal hardware-GPU guarantee.
